Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 4

“Arjuna said: How can I fight Bhishma and Drona with arrows in battle, Madhusudana, when both of them deserve my worship, destroyer of enemies?”

Arjuna answers challenge with a real difficulty. These are not enemies but the men who raised and trained him. To fire arrows at them inverts a lifetime of reverence — his objection is moral, not cowardly.
